front.title: UTXO6-DNS: Resolving Payment Endpoints via Private-use RRTYPE and Prefix Isolation

abstract.t:
This document specifies the _utxo application namespace for DNS. It defines how wallet clients and TEE (Trusted Execution Environment) applications resolve verifiable payment endpoints and blockchain UTXO (Unspent Transaction Output) references using DNS.
To avoid exacerbating public RRTYPE space congestion and DNS-layer transparent parsing, this document utilizes the RFC 3597 Private-use space (QTYPE 65400). The DNS protocol does not parse the payload. Application semantics are isolated strictly via the _utxo underscore prefix in the owner name, while the RDATA consists of a purely opaque CBOR-encoded byte stream.
